message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; files are opened and used directly without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Although smart_open is imported (suggesting possible remote access), no checksums, signed URLs, pinned revisions, or authentication mechanisms are implemented when fetching data.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools are used anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering are applied to the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained DenseNet121 weights are loaded via torchvision with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision, and checkpoint loading in load_checkpoint only checks file existence without any integrity verification.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Adam optimizer with no DP-SGD, Opacus, or TensorFlow Privacy integration.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train and test dataloaders appear to be separate, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on incoming data before passing it to the models; images are loaded and passed directly.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (feature embeddings, domain predictions) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision model (sketch-based image retrieval), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
